scenes.stage_direction: Adrian's surviving records reopen grief. Leave a pause around Amara's response; David does not speak over it.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: The change was made after Adrian died.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: He would have challenged that time. He hated being called late when he wasn't.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: The person responsible is linked to the current receiving authority.

metadata.evidence_summary: The alteration happened after Adrian could challenge it.
